name: Decider potato
summary: Pick the person, not the place: a hot potato hops around the circle of friends, faster and faster, and pops on whoever decides; they get 60 seconds and their pick is final.
useWhen: 'can someone just decide' after the chat has gone in circles
the group wants one person to make the call, no appeals
the same people always end up deciding
dontUseWhen: the group wants to vote (use a poll or after-vote)
picking a place at random (use claw-pick or slot-machine)

params.title: string
params.sub: the moment, e.g. “can someone just decide” ×3
params.people: up to 8 x {name, decided (times this semester), would (their pick if they're not in the chat), said}
params.ideas: up to 4 places floated in the chat
